categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Runyang New Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polyolefin foam materials, especially electronic irradiated cross-linked polyethylene (IXPE) foam. The company also produces related products such as GFOAM, EVA foam, and air column bags, serving industries including home building decoration, automotive interiors, baby products, sports, consumer electronics, household appliances, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced irradiation cross-linking technology to produce IXPE foam, employing processes such as extrusion molding, irradiation cross-linking, and high-temperature foaming. It holds multiple patents and emphasizes environmentally friendly, non-toxic, and high-performance materials with properties like shock absorption, insulation, antibacterial, and flame retardancy. The company also integrates intelligent manufacturing and digital upgrades to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic PVC plastic flooring manufacturers and global top-tier home building material retailers such as HomeDepot. The company serves diverse downstream industries including home building decoration, automotive interiors, baby products, sports, consumer electronics, household appliances, and medical equipment. It has expanded into emerging sectors like new energy vehicles and smart baby products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Zhejiang province, and overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam and Thailand, strategically located near major downstream PVC flooring manufacturers. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore for investment and management purposes. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with significant revenue growth from overseas markets, especially Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: Runyang operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing soft foam plastic materials. It procures raw materials such as synthetic resins and foaming agents from upstream chemical producers and supplies finished foam products to downstream industries including construction, automotive, baby products, and packaging sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in environmentally friendly, biodegradable, flame-retardant, and high-performance foam materials using irradiation cross-linking technology. It invests in product innovation to meet diversified and high-end market demands, including smart baby products and automotive applications. Strategic focus includes expanding production capacity, enhancing intelligent manufacturing, and deepening market penetration in emerging sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of foam plastic products, including IXPE and related materials, to domestic and international customers. The company employs a direct sales model supported by technical service and after-sales support, with no significant reliance on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Runyang is one of the leading domestic producers of IXPE foam materials, recognized for its technological innovation and product quality. It holds a competitive position by supplying major PVC flooring manufacturers and global retailers. The company emphasizes its patented technologies, quality certifications, and close collaboration with top downstream customers to maintain its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 406.5 million, a 13.16% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 25.44 million, a decline of 39.51%. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 1.33 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion projects, including overseas facilities. Despite profit pressure from increased costs and some business losses, the company maintains steady revenue growth and positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Runyang emphasizes its environmentally friendly, non-toxic, and high-performance foam materials with superior physical properties such as shock absorption, insulation, antibacterial and flame-retardant features. Its products meet stringent international standards and have passed rigorous testing by global certification bodies like Intertek. The company differentiates itself through patented technologies, customized product solutions, and integration with leading downstream customers, enabling it to serve high-value and specialized market segments.
